english.title: Producer fail to adopt measures to enable him / her to be informed of risks relating to product and act to avoid risks
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a producer, failed, within the limits of your activities, to adopt measures commensurate with the characteristics of the products you supplied, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCTS..), to enable you to be informed of the risks which the products might pose and to take appropriate action
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7(3) and 20(2) of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
A magistrates' court may try an information in respect of an offence under these Regulations if the information is laid within three years from the date of the offence or within one year from the discovery of the offence by the prosecutor whichever is the earlier (regulation 41).

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
